title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Payments Risk Rule on Exit Settlement Share for Recently Joined Card Plans
content:
**Rule.** When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, the share of the exit settlement sum that is paid depends on how long the account has been on the plan being left: an account whose latest plan change (or, when it never changed plan, its opening) was fewer than 6 whole months ago and that has no cashback payment in the last 3 months is settled at half; such an account with one or more cashback payments in the last 3 months is settled at 0.8 of the sum; any other account is settled in full.

**Terms.**
- The sum is the settlement's capped statement month together with the older unpaid cashback.
- Time on the plan is counted in whole months from the account's plan change date, or from its opening date when the account has never changed plan, to the day of the move.
- "The last 3 months" counts the cashback payments on the account booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the move.
- The share is applied without rounding at this point; the settlement is rounded to the cent only on its final figure.

| Whole months on the plan being left | Cashback payments in the last 3 months | Share paid |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 6 | none | 0.5 (half) |
| fewer than 6 | 1 or more | 0.8 |
| 6 or more | any number | in full, no reduction |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs, sum 40.00)

- Plan change 5 whole months before the move, no cashback payment in the last 3 months: 0.5 of 40.00, which is 20.00.
- Plan change 5 whole months before the move, one cashback payment 2 months before: 0.8 of 40.00, which is 32.00.
- Plan change exactly 6 whole months before the move: paid in full, 40.00, whatever the payment history.
- Never changed plan, opened 3 whole months before the move, no payment: 0.5 of 40.00, which is 20.00.
